feed.title: NPR Programs: All Things Considered
feed.subtitle: All Things Considered hosts Ailsa Chang, Mary Louise Kelly, Juana Summers and Scott Detrow present the program's trademark mix of news, interviews, commentaries, reviews, and offbeat features 7 days a week.

entry.title: What the blue wave looked like in North Carolina
entry.summary: Democrats have flipped five Republican-held congressional seats in North Carolina. The surprising results were just one part of the blue wave in a swing state that President Trump won three times.

entry.title: Newsom announces he will commute sentences of inmates on California's death row
entry.summary: California Gov. Gavin Newsom announced that he's commuting the sentences of all inmates on the state's Death Row. The governor says at 548 people, it's the largest death row in the Western Hemisphere.

entry.title: With stubbornly high interest rates, some are reconsidering adjustable-rate mortgages
entry.summary: With the rates for 30-year fixed-rate mortgages at 7% or more, is it time to reconsider the far less popular adjustable-rate mortgage? New analysis shows that ARMs have paid off for borrowers.

entry.title: AI shares sink after blue wave
entry.summary: Shares sank, with the tech-heavy Nasdaq dropping over 5%, as investors reacted with fear that a Democratic Congress -- and states across the country -- would crack down on AI data centers.

entry.title: Voters are fed up with high prices. Here's what the new Congress could do to help
entry.summary: Democrats achieved stunning midterm victories. The party will take control of Congress next year. What does it mean for the economy?

entry.title: In California, some towns are already dealing with impacts from El Niño
entry.summary: What could be the effects of an extreme El Nino this winter on California, and how are towns preparing?

entry.title: Pasture mealybugs have killed off huge swaths of grasses in the Southeast
entry.summary: An invasive insect that's tough to detect and eliminate poses a multi-billion dollar threat to the agricultural economy — adding another stressor to farmers already stretched by high costs.

entry.title: Remote Alaska village is still recovering from 2025 storm
entry.summary: Last October, remnants of a typhoon slammed into the Western Alaska coast. We hear from the ground from Kipnuk about how people are trying to rebuild enough to move back.

entry.title: Blue wave: what's next for ICE?
entry.summary: Democrats' historic victory could mean more oversight at the Department of Homeland Security.

entry.title: A volunteer acting group made up of retirees delights people in senior living spaces
entry.summary: A group of retirees volunteers as actors to perform for seniors. We meet the Golden Guild of Michigan.
